roles.background: polarized VHS, Hodge loci, variational Hodge
roles.delegated_check: Verify exact rational/smooth-projective scope, algebraic Hodge-branch model, and that formal effectivity does not imply class identity or initial algebraicity.
roles.finding: Scope is coherent if the completed local ring is taken from an algebraic Hodge-locus branch; CDK supports algebraicity of the Hodge locus. Class identity remains separate.

roles.background: Hilbert/Chow schemes, algebraic cycles, relative moduli
roles.delegated_check: Check signed rational witness bookkeeping and whether componentwise closed-subscheme effectivity preserves the fixed coefficient vector.
roles.finding: A fixed finite denominator-cleared component indexing can be algebraized componentwise; component switching or a different witness category is not solved.

roles.background: Artin rings, formal deformation theory, obstruction towers
roles.delegated_check: Distinguish one lift per order from a compatible inverse system and test the exact theorem hypotheses.
roles.finding: Compatibility is essential. The candidate must not credit arbitrary per-order existence as a formal object.

roles.background: Grothendieck existence, Artin approximation, formal geometry
roles.delegated_check: Verify what Grothendieck existence actually gives and where the completion-to-neighborhood boundary lies.
roles.finding: Stacks tag 0898 gives closed-subscheme effectivity over Spec(A) for compatible towers with proper special fibre. It does not by itself descend the resulting object to an open/etale neighborhood of the original branch.

roles.background: scheme-theoretic boundary cases, properness, singular/nonreduced geometry
roles.delegated_check: Try hostile cases: incompatible lifts, coefficient switching, nonreduced target, completion-only points.
roles.finding: Each hostile case survives unless explicitly excluded; therefore the result must be a scoped transfer lemma, not variational Hodge.

roles.delegated_check: Classify authority, local-vs-gluing failure, novelty and retained semantic axes.
roles.finding: No new mathematical theorem: novelty class TRANSFER/REPRESENTATION. Formal effectivity over completion is locally closed under hypotheses; descent is a distinct gluing residual. No root or independent-review authority.

consensus: Proceed with a counterexample-first discriminator: attempt to falsify the exact implication compatible closed-subscheme tower -> algebraic closed subscheme over the completed local base. If source theorem matches exactly, record only a source-bound transfer and split the residual; do not promote to a Hodge theorem.
